title: Conference Speaking And Presentation Skills: Mike Hall Interviews Angelique Martin | SCNA 2013

dimensions.historical_context_at_recording: SCNA 2013 (5th anniversary edition), introducing the Code and Coffee morning sessions, 5K community run traditions, and balancing high-touch craft conferences under non-profit budgets.
dimensions.subsequent_history_and_trajectory: SCNA became one of the quintessential software craftsmanship gatherings, pioneering intimate single-track developer conferences.
